bug_semantics: In the affected ClassroomIO UI, an authenticated student visiting the Explore page receives published courses through the shared Courses/Card component. The card's action-menu guard excludes LMS and landing-page cards but does not exclude isExplore cards, and its Delete action navigates to /courses/{id}/settings#delete. Confirming there calls the browser-side deleteCourse service, which updates the selected course row to status DELETED through Supabase. The v0.1.13 course UPDATE RLS policy delegates to is_user_in_group_with_role(group_id), whose UUID overload accepts any organization member having any non-null role rather than requiring ADMIN/TUTOR, so a student can soft-delete an administrator's published course.
flaw_origin: The final causal edge was introduced by 80dc3923461b21699a17157bdfdb050694fca1a5: it replaced the shared course card's non-functional 'WIP: Delete course' alert with a real goto(`/courses/${id}/settings#delete`) action while retaining the menu guard {#if !isLMS && !isOnLandingPage}, which failed to exclude cards rendered by the already-existing student Explore page. Older commits supplied prerequisites rather than the smallest BIC: 98575e4dd9510c60da58e666d27286f8151e9225 (squashed from the PR branch beginning at 3502dedabb9fb3f641a7f510a47435c55f5fd10a) created Explore with the shared card while Delete was still only an alert, and 6ef33cbfd09d01181423861182561692f08ca116 created the browser-side course deletion sink. Commit 80dc3923461b21699a17157bdfdb050694fca1a5 is therefore the smallest commit that first made the disclosed Explore-click path perform deletion.

reasoning: The advisory and reporter reproduction define a specific causal path: a student uses Explore's visible Delete action and the course is removed. History separates its prerequisites from its introducer. The raw client-side delete primitive originated in 2021, and the student Explore page landed in 2024, but the Explore card's Delete handler was still a harmless WIP alert. Commit 80dc3923461b21699a17157bdfdb050694fca1a5 is the first smallest commit to replace that alert with real navigation to the settings deletion flow while leaving the shared menu visible in Explore context. Its direct parent proves the functional edge absent. In v0.1.13 the destination invokes a direct Supabase status update, while RLS treats every organization member with a non-null role—including students—as authorized for course UPDATE, completing the unauthorized soft-delete path. The BIC precedes the affected v0.1.2-v0.2.11 source-derived tag interval and the specifically reported v0.1.13. The focused branch fix b4326e6517e0b9f058dfe86c173b0c10d58c3b35 replaces student-permitting courseMemberMiddleware with ADMIN/TUTOR/org-admin courseTeamMemberMiddleware; squash 1e9a82e912736d87092715fae13329b76254d052 lands that change, and v0.3.0 is the first containing tag. The BIC commit object has no AI marker, so later AI involvement in the fix cannot attribute the flaw: NOT_AI.
